description:
Dokumentasi seminar. 40 pembicara. Dua hari. Setiap pembicara mendapat set portreit dalam 24 jam setelah sesi mereka.

14 dari 40 pembicara menggunakan foto tersebut di media sosial mereka dalam 48 jam. Jangkauan organik klien kami berlipat ganda tanpa biaya distribusi tambahan.

Satu event. Puluhan titik distribusi yang tidak direncanakan.

Berapa lama biasanya pembicara di event kamu menunggu foto mereka setelah acara selesai?

---

Seminar documentation. 40 speakers. Two days. Every speaker received a portrait set within 24 hours of their session.

14 of the 40 speakers used those photos on their own social channels within 48 hours. Our client's organic reach doubled with no additional distribution cost.

One event. Dozens of unplanned distribution points.

How long do speakers at your events usually wait before receiving their photos after the event ends?

If you need company profile photos or headshots that feel clean and credible, message us. We'll share a sample shot list and a clear turnaround timeline.
